description: Tucked away and remarkably quiet, private rear unit in the heart of Studio City. This exceptional residence offers a rare sense of privacy and separation from the energy of the street, creating an unexpected retreat in one of the neighborhood's most vibrant locations. The bright and inviting single-level layout features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area anchored by a cozy fireplace and private balcony, perfect for morning coffee or unwinding at the end of the day. The kitchen is tastefully updated with sleek modern countertops, stylish cabinetry, and stainless steel appliances including a double oven range.The spacious primary suite includes a beautifully remodeled en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet with in-unit washer and dryer. A well-separated second bedroom, ideal for guests or a home office, offers generous closet space and access to a fully remodeled hall bathroom, both updated by the current owner with a clean, modern aesthetic. Both bedrooms are positioned for privacy with no direct-facing units. Additional features include engineered wood and LVT flooring, central air and heat, dual-pane windows, recessed lighting, crown moldings, and custom window treatments throughout. This boutique, controlled-access building offers an on-site gym, two side-by-side parking spaces, and dedicated storage. Ideally located near Ventura Boulevard, The Shops at Sportsmen's Lodge, and with easy freeway access.A rare combination of privacy, updates, and location, move-in ready and quietly set where you want to be in Studio City.
